en.text: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

zhSimplified.text: 非斯都既然定规了，叫我们坐船往意大利去，便将保罗和别的囚犯交给御营里的一个百夫长，名叫犹流。

zhTraditional.text: 非斯都既然定規了，叫我們坐船往意大利去，便將保羅和別的囚犯交給御營裏的一個百夫長，名叫猶流。

en.text: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

zhSimplified.text: 有一只亚大米田的船，要沿着亚细亚一带地方的海边走，我们就上了那船开行；有马其顿的帖撒罗尼迦人亚里达古和我们同去。

zhTraditional.text: 有一隻亞大米田的船，要沿着亞細亞一帶地方的海邊走，我們就上了那船開行；有馬其頓的帖撒羅尼迦人亞里達古和我們同去。

en.text: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

zhSimplified.text: 第二天，到了西顿；犹流宽待保罗，准他往朋友那里去，受他们的照应。

zhTraditional.text: 第二天，到了西頓；猶流寬待保羅，准他往朋友那裏去，受他們的照應。

en.text: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

zhSimplified.text: 从那里又开船，因为风不顺，就贴着塞浦路斯背风岸行去。

zhTraditional.text: 從那裏又開船，因為風不順，就貼着塞浦路斯背風岸行去。

en.text: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

zhSimplified.text: 过了基利家、旁非利亚前面的海，就到了吕家的每拉。

zhTraditional.text: 過了基利家、旁非利亞前面的海，就到了呂家的每拉。

en.text: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

zhSimplified.text: 在那里，百夫长遇见一只亚历山大的船，要往意大利去，便叫我们上了那船。

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏，百夫長遇見一隻亞歷山大的船，要往意大利去，便叫我們上了那船。

en.text: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

zhSimplified.text: 一连多日，船行得慢，仅仅来到革尼土的对面。因为被风拦阻，就贴着克里特背风岸，从撒摩尼对面行过。

zhTraditional.text: 一連多日，船行得慢，僅僅來到革尼土的對面。因為被風攔阻，就貼着克里特背風岸，從撒摩尼對面行過。

en.text: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

zhSimplified.text: 我们沿岸行走，仅仅来到一个地方，名叫佳澳；离那里不远，有拉西亚城。

zhTraditional.text: 我們沿岸行走，僅僅來到一個地方，名叫佳澳；離那裏不遠，有拉西亞城。

en.text: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

zhSimplified.text: 走的日子多了，已经过了禁食的节期，行船又危险，保罗就劝众人说：

zhTraditional.text: 走的日子多了，已經過了禁食的節期，行船又危險，保羅就勸眾人說：

en.text: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

zhSimplified.text: 「众位，我看这次行船，不但货物和船要受损伤，大遭破坏，连我们的性命也难保。」

zhTraditional.text: 「眾位，我看這次行船，不但貨物和船要受損傷，大遭破壞，連我們的性命也難保。」

en.text: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

zhSimplified.text: 但百夫长信从掌船的和船主，不信从保罗所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 但百夫長信從掌船的和船主，不信從保羅所說的。

en.text: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

zhSimplified.text: 且因在这海口过冬不便，船上的人就多半说，不如开船离开这地方，或者能到菲尼基过冬。菲尼基是克里特的一个海口，一面朝东北，一面朝东南。

zhTraditional.text: 且因在這海口過冬不便，船上的人就多半說，不如開船離開這地方，或者能到菲尼基過冬。菲尼基是克里特的一個海口，一面朝東北，一面朝東南。

en.text: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

zhSimplified.text: 这时，微微起了南风，他们以为得意，就起了锚，贴近克里特行去。

zhTraditional.text: 這時，微微起了南風，他們以為得意，就起了錨，貼近克里特行去。

en.text: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

zhSimplified.text: 不多几时，狂风从岛上扑下来；那风名叫「友拉革罗」。

zhTraditional.text: 不多幾時，狂風從島上撲下來；那風名叫「友拉革羅」。

en.text: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

zhSimplified.text: 船被风抓住，敌不住风，我们就任风刮去。

zhTraditional.text: 船被風抓住，敵不住風，我們就任風颳去。

en.text: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

zhSimplified.text: 贴着一个小岛的背风岸奔行，那岛名叫高大，在那里仅仅收住了小船。

zhTraditional.text: 貼着一個小島的背風岸奔行，那島名叫高大，在那裏僅僅收住了小船。

en.text: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

zhSimplified.text: 既然把小船拉上来，就用缆索捆绑船底，又恐怕在赛耳底沙滩上搁了浅，就落下篷来，任船飘去。

zhTraditional.text: 既然把小船拉上來，就用纜索捆綁船底，又恐怕在賽耳底沙灘上擱了淺，就落下篷來，任船飄去。

en.text: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

zhSimplified.text: 我们被风浪逼得甚急，第二天众人就把货物抛在海里。

zhTraditional.text: 我們被風浪逼得甚急，第二天眾人就把貨物拋在海裏。

en.text: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

zhSimplified.text: 到第三天，他们又亲手把船上的器具抛弃了。

zhTraditional.text: 到第三天，他們又親手把船上的器具拋棄了。

en.text: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.

zhSimplified.text: 太阳和星辰多日不显露，又有狂风大浪催逼，我们得救的指望就都绝了。

zhTraditional.text: 太陽和星辰多日不顯露，又有狂風大浪催逼，我們得救的指望就都絕了。

en.text: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

zhSimplified.text: 众人多日没有吃什么，保罗就出来站在他们中间，说：「众位，你们本该听我的话，不离开克里特，免得遭这样的伤损破坏。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人多日沒有吃甚麼，保羅就出來站在他們中間，說：「眾位，你們本該聽我的話，不離開克里特，免得遭這樣的傷損破壞。

en.text: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

zhSimplified.text: 现在我还劝你们放心，你们的性命一个也不失丧，惟独失丧这船。

zhTraditional.text: 現在我還勸你們放心，你們的性命一個也不失喪，惟獨失喪這船。

en.text: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

zhSimplified.text: 因我所属所事奉的 神，他的使者昨夜站在我旁边，说：

zhTraditional.text: 因我所屬所事奉的上帝，他的使者昨夜站在我旁邊，說：

en.text: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

zhSimplified.text: 『保罗，不要害怕，你必定站在凯撒面前，并且与你同船的人， 神都赐给你了。』

zhTraditional.text: 『保羅，不要害怕，你必定站在凱撒面前，並且與你同船的人，上帝都賜給你了。』

en.text: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

zhSimplified.text: 所以众位可以放心，我信 神他怎样对我说，事情也要怎样成就。

zhTraditional.text: 所以眾位可以放心，我信上帝他怎樣對我說，事情也要怎樣成就。

en.text: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

zhSimplified.text: 只是我们必要撞在一个岛上。」

zhTraditional.text: 只是我們必要撞在一個島上。」

en.text: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

zhSimplified.text: 到了第十四天夜间，船在亚得里亚海飘来飘去。约到半夜，水手以为渐近旱地，

zhTraditional.text: 到了第十四天夜間，船在亞得里亞海飄來飄去。約到半夜，水手以為漸近旱地，

en.text: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.

zhSimplified.text: 就探深浅，探得有十二丈；稍往前行，又探深浅，探得有九丈。

zhTraditional.text: 就探深淺，探得有十二丈；稍往前行，又探深淺，探得有九丈。

en.text: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

zhSimplified.text: 恐怕撞在石头上，就从船尾抛下四个锚，盼望天亮。

zhTraditional.text: 恐怕撞在石頭上，就從船尾拋下四個錨，盼望天亮。

en.text: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,

zhSimplified.text: 水手想要逃出船去，把小船放在海里，假作要从船头抛锚的样子。

zhTraditional.text: 水手想要逃出船去，把小船放在海裏，假作要從船頭拋錨的樣子。

en.text: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗对百夫长和兵丁说：「这些人若不等在船上，你们必不能得救。」

zhTraditional.text: 保羅對百夫長和兵丁說：「這些人若不等在船上，你們必不能得救。」

en.text: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.

zhSimplified.text: 于是兵丁砍断小船的绳子，由它飘去。

zhTraditional.text: 於是兵丁砍斷小船的繩子，由它飄去。

en.text: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 天渐亮的时候，保罗劝众人都吃饭，说：「你们悬望忍饿不吃什么，已经十四天了。

zhTraditional.text: 天漸亮的時候，保羅勸眾人都吃飯，說：「你們懸望忍餓不吃甚麼，已經十四天了。

en.text: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以我劝你们吃饭，这是关乎你们救命的事；因为你们各人连一根头发也不至于损坏。」

zhTraditional.text: 所以我勸你們吃飯，這是關乎你們救命的事；因為你們各人連一根頭髮也不至於損壞。」

en.text: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

zhSimplified.text: 保罗说了这话，就拿着饼，在众人面前祝谢了 神，擘开吃。

zhTraditional.text: 保羅說了這話，就拿着餅，在眾人面前祝謝了上帝，擘開吃。

en.text: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

zhSimplified.text: 于是他们都放下心，也就吃了。

zhTraditional.text: 於是他們都放下心，也就吃了。

en.text: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

zhSimplified.text: 我们在船上的共有二百七十六个人。

zhTraditional.text: 我們在船上的共有二百七十六個人。

en.text: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 他们吃饱了，就把船上的麦子抛在海里，为要叫船轻一点。

zhTraditional.text: 他們吃飽了，就把船上的麥子拋在海裏，為要叫船輕一點。

en.text: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

zhSimplified.text: 到了天亮，他们不认识那地方，但见一个海湾，有岸可登，就商议能把船拢进去不能。

zhTraditional.text: 到了天亮，他們不認識那地方，但見一個海灣，有岸可登，就商議能把船攏進去不能。

en.text: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

zhSimplified.text: 于是砍断缆索，弃锚在海里；同时也松开舵绳，拉起头篷，顺着风向岸行去。

zhTraditional.text: 於是砍斷纜索，棄錨在海裏；同時也鬆開舵繩，拉起頭篷，順着風向岸行去。

en.text: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

zhSimplified.text: 但遇着两水夹流的地方，就把船搁了浅；船头胶住不动，船尾被浪的猛力冲坏。

zhTraditional.text: 但遇着兩水夾流的地方，就把船擱了淺；船頭膠住不動，船尾被浪的猛力衝壞。

en.text: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

zhSimplified.text: 兵丁的意思要把囚犯杀了，恐怕有洑水脱逃的。

zhTraditional.text: 兵丁的意思要把囚犯殺了，恐怕有洑水脫逃的。

en.text: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

zhSimplified.text: 但百夫长要救保罗，不准他们任意而行，就吩咐会洑水的，跳下水去先上岸；

zhTraditional.text: 但百夫長要救保羅，不准他們任意而行，就吩咐會洑水的，跳下水去先上岸；

en.text: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

zhSimplified.text: 其余的人可以用板子或船上的零碎东西上岸。这样，众人都得了救，上了岸。

zhTraditional.text: 其餘的人可以用板子或船上的零碎東西上岸。這樣，眾人都得了救，上了岸。
